title: अष्टात्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Balarama stays at the hermitage of Mankanaka and then goes to the tirtha where the sage Mahodara was freed of the skull stuck to his thigh. After praising the holy place and ascetics there, Balarama passes on to the next tirthas.
summary.kn: ಬಲರಾಮ ಮಂಕಣಕನ ಆಶ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ತಂಗಿ ನಂತರ ಮಹೋದರ ಋಷಿ ತೊಡೆಗೆ ಅಂಟಿದ ತಲೆಬುರುಡೆಯಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತನಾದ ತೀರ್ಥಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಳ ಮತ್ತು ತಪಸ್ವಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಗಳಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ತೀರ್ಥಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: बलराम मंकणक के आश्रम में ठहरते हैं और फिर उस तीर्थ पर जाते हैं जहाँ ऋषि महोदर जंघा से चिपकी खोपड़ी से मुक्त हुए थे। वहाँ के पवित्र स्थान और तपस्वियों की प्रशंसा कर वे अगले तीर्थों की ओर बढ़ते हैं।
summary.te: బలరాముడు మంకణకుని ఆశ్రమంలో ఉండి తరువాత మహోదర ఋషి తొడకు అంటిన కపాలం నుండి విముక్తి పొందిన తీర్థానికి వెళతాడు. ఆ పుణ్యస్థలాన్ని, తపస్వులను ప్రశంసించి తదుపరి తీర్థాలకు వెళతాడు.
summary.ta: பலராமன் மங்கணகரின் ஆசிரமத்தில் தங்கி, பின் முனிவர் மகோதரர் தொடையில் ஒட்டிய மண்டையோட்டிலிருந்து விடுபட்ட தீர்த்தத்துக்குச் செல்கிறான். அப்புனித இடத்தையும் தவசிகளையும் புகழ்ந்து அடுத்த தீர்த்தங்களுக்குச் செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ബലരാമൻ മങ്കണകന്റെ ആശ്രമത്തിൽ താമസിച്ച ശേഷം, തുടയിൽ ഒട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ച തലയോട്ടിയിൽനിന്ന് മഹോദരൻ എന്ന ഋഷി മോചിതനായ കപാലമോചനം തീർത്ഥത്തിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നു. അവിടത്തെ പുണ്യസ്ഥലത്തെയും തപസ്വികളെയും പ്രശംസിച്ചശേഷം അദ്ദേഹം അടുത്ത തീർത്ഥങ്ങളിലേക്ക് കടക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.38; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

sections.title: सारस्वतपर्व
sections.titleEn: Sarasvata Parva (Balarama's pilgrimage on the Sarasvati)

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
उषित्वा तत्र रामस्तु संपूज्याश्रमवासिनः ।
तथा मङ्कणके प्रीतिं शुभां चक्रे हलायुधः ॥

meaning.en: After staying there and honoring the dwellers of the hermitage, Halayudha Rama also showed kindly affection to Mankanaka.

verses.text:
दत्त्वा दानं द्विजातिभ्यो रजनीं तामुपोष्य च ।
पूजितो मुनिसंघैश्च प्रातरुत्थाय लाङ्गली ॥

meaning.en: He gave gifts to the Brahmins, spent that night fasting, was honored by the groups of sages, and rose at dawn, the plough-bearer.

verses.text:
अनुज्ञाप्य मुनीन्सर्वान्स्पृष्ट्वा तोयं च भारत ।
प्रययौ त्वरितो रामस्तीर्थहेतोर्महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Having taken leave of all the sages and touched the water, Bharata, the mighty Rama set out in haste for the sake of tirthas.

verses.text:
तत औशनसं तीर्थमाजगाम हलायुधः ।
कपालमोचनं नाम यत्र मुक्तो महामुनिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Halayudha came to the tirtha of Ushanas, called Kapalamochana, where a great sage was freed.

verses.text:
महता शिरसा राजन्ग्रस्तजङ्घो महोदरः ।
राक्षसस्य महाराज रामक्षिप्तस्य वै पुरा ॥

meaning.en: King, the head of a rakshasa, cast down long ago by Rama, had seized the leg of Mahodara.

verses.text:
तत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं काव्येन सुमहात्मना ।
यत्रास्य नीतिरखिला प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः ।
तत्रस्थश्चिन्तयामास दैत्यदानवविग्रहम् ॥

meaning.en: There long ago the great-souled Kavya, Shukra, practiced austerity, and there all his political wisdom appeared; staying there he reflected on the war of the Daityas and Danavas.

verses.text:
तत्प्राप्य च बलो राजंस्तीर्थप्रवरमुत्तमम् ।
विधिवद्धि ददौ वित्तं ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching that best and finest tirtha, king, Balarama duly gave wealth to the great-souled Brahmins.

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कपालमोचनं ब्रह्मन्कथं यत्र महामुनिः ।
मुक्तः कथं चास्य शिरो लग्नं केन च हेतुना ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, how was the great sage freed at Kapalamochana, how did the head cling to him, and for what reason?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
पुरा वै दण्डकारण्ये राघवेण महात्मना ।
वसता राजशार्दूल राक्षसास्तत्र हिंसिताः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, tiger among kings, when the great-souled Raghava, Rama, was living in the Dandaka forest, rakshasas there were slain.

verses.text:
जनस्थाने शिरश्छिन्नं राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः ।
क्षुरेण शितधारेण तत्पपात महावने ॥

meaning.en: In Janasthana the head of a wicked rakshasa was cut off by a sharp-edged razor-arrow, and it fell in the great forest.

verses.text:
महोदरस्य तल्लग्नं जङ्घायां वै यदृच्छया ।
वने विचरतो राजन्नस्थि भित्त्वास्फुरत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: By chance it stuck to the thigh of Mahodara as he walked in the forest, king, and pierced the bone and throbbed.

verses.text:
स तेन लग्नेन तदा द्विजातिर्न शशाक ह ।
अभिगन्तुं महाप्राज्ञस्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ॥

meaning.en: Because of that attached head the twice-born sage could not go to tirthas and holy places, though he was very wise.

verses.text:
स पूतिना विस्रवता वेदनार्तो महामुनिः ।
जगाम सर्वतीर्थानि पृथिव्यामिति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Tormented by pain from the foul, oozing wound, that great sage, we have heard, went to all the tirthas of the earth.

verses.text:
स गत्वा सरितः सर्वाः समुद्रांश्च महातपाः ।
कथयामास तत्सर्वमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: That greatly austere one went to all the rivers and seas, and told all of it to sages of refined souls.

verses.text:
आप्लुतः सर्वतीर्थेषु न च मोक्षमवाप्तवान् ।
स तु शुश्राव विप्रेन्द्रो मुनीनां वचनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Though he bathed at all the tirthas, he did not gain release. Then the best of Brahmins heard the great words of the sages.

verses.text:
सरस्वत्यास्तीर्थवरं ख्यातमौशनसं तदा ।
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सिद्धक्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: They spoke of the best tirtha of the Sarasvati, famed then as the tirtha of Ushanas, the supreme sacred field of siddhas that calms all sins.

verses.text:
स तु गत्वा ततस्तत्र तीर्थमौशनसं द्विजः ।
तत औशनसे तीर्थे तस्योपस्पृशतस्तदा ।
तच्छिरश्चरणं मुक्त्वा पपातान्तर्जले तदा ॥

meaning.en: That Brahmin went to the tirtha of Ushanas, and as he touched the water there, the head let go of his leg and fell into the water.

verses.text:
ततः स विरुजो राजन्पूतात्मा वीतकल्मषः ।
आजगामाश्रमं प्रीतः कृतकृत्यो महोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Then, king, Mahodara, free of pain, purified and without sin, came back to his hermitage, glad and with his purpose done.

verses.text:
सोऽथ गत्वाश्रमं पुण्यं विप्रमुक्तो महातपाः ।
कथयामास तत्सर्वमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Going to his holy hermitage, freed, that greatly austere one told all this to sages of refined souls.

verses.text:
ते श्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य ततस्तीर्थस्य मानद ।
कपालमोचनमिति नाम चक्रुः समागताः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, giver of honor, those gathered gave that tirtha the name Kapalamochana, "freeing from the skull."

verses.text:
तत्र दत्त्वा बहून्दायान्विप्रान्संपूज्य माधवः ।
जगाम वृष्णिप्रवरो रुषङ्गोराश्रमं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Giving many gifts there and honoring the Brahmins, Balarama, the Vrishnis' best, descendant of Madhu, then went to the hermitage of Rushangu.

verses.text:
यत्र तप्तं तपो घोरमार्ष्टिषेणेन भारत ।
ब्राह्मण्यं लब्धवांस्तत्र विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥

meaning.en: There, Bharata, Arshtishena practiced fierce austerity, and there the great sage Vishvamitra gained Brahmin status.

verses.text:
ततो हलधरः श्रीमान्ब्राह्मणैः परिवारितः ।
जगाम यत्र राजेन्द्र रुषङ्गुस्तनुमत्यजत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the plough-bearer, glorious and surrounded by Brahmins, went to where Rushangu gave up his body, king of kings.

verses.text:
रुषङ्गुर्ब्राह्मणो वृद्धस्तपोनित्यश्च भारत ।
देहन्यासे कृतमना विचिन्त्य बहुधा बहु ॥

meaning.en: Rushangu was an aged Brahmin, constant in austerity, Bharata; after much thought in many ways he set his mind on laying down his body.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वानुपादाय तनयान्वै महातपाः ।
रुषङ्गुरब्रवीत्तत्र नयध्वं मा पृथूदकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then that greatly austere one, taking all his sons, said there: take me to Prithudaka.

verses.text:
विज्ञायातीतवयसं रुषङ्गुं ते तपोधनाः ।
तं वै तीर्थमुपानिन्युः सरस्वत्यास्तपोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing Rushangu was past his years, those ascetics brought the ascetic to that tirtha of the Sarasvati.

verses.text:
स तैः पुत्रैस्तदा धीमानानीतो वै सरस्वतीम् ।
पुण्यां तीर्थशतोपेतां विप्रसंघैर्निषेविताम् ॥

meaning.en: Brought by his sons, that wise one reached the holy Sarasvati, with her hundred tirthas, visited by crowds of Brahmins.

verses.text:
स तत्र विधिना राजन्नाप्लुतः सुमहातपाः ।
ज्ञात्वा तीर्थगुणांश्चैव प्राहेदमृषिसत्तमः ।
सुप्रीतः पुरुषव्याघ्र सर्वान्पुत्रानुपासतः ॥

meaning.en: There, king, the greatly austere best of sages bathed by rule, and knowing the tirtha's virtues, he happily said this to all his sons attending him, tiger among men.

verses.text:
सरस्वत्युत्तरे तीरे यस्त्यजेदात्मनस्तनुम् ।
पृथूदके जप्यपरो नैनं श्वोमरणं तपेत् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever gives up his body on the Sarasvati's northern bank at Prithudaka, intent on prayer, death will not trouble him on the morrow.

verses.text:
तत्राप्लुत्य स धर्मात्मा उपस्पृश्य हलायुधः ।
दत्त्वा चैव बहून्दायान्विप्राणां विप्रवत्सलः ॥

meaning.en: The righteous Halayudha, devoted to Brahmins, bathed and touched water there and gave many gifts to Brahmins.

verses.text:
ससर्ज यत्र भगवाँल्लोकाँल्लोकपितामहः ।
यत्रार्ष्टिषेणः कौरव्य ब्राह्मण्यं संशितव्रतः ।
तपसा महता राजन्प्राप्तवानृषिसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Where the blessed Grandfather of the worlds created the worlds, where Arshtishena, Kaurava, of keen vows, won Brahmin status by great austerity, best of sages;

verses.text:
सिन्धुद्वीपश्च राजर्षिर्देवापिश्च महातपाः ।
ब्राह्मण्यं लब्धवान्यत्र विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।
महातपस्वी भगवानुग्रतेजा महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: where the royal sage Sindhudvipa and the greatly austere Devapi, and the great sage Vishvamitra, the blessed one of fierce brilliance and great austerity, gained Brahmin status,

verses.text: तत्राजगाम बलवान्बलभद्रः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: there came the mighty and glorious Balabhadra.
